verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows a versioned public API or a documented deprecation policy for Figma Make. Community reports say Figma's API returns 400 for .make files and the format is undocumented, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The app 'version history' feature is about project revisions, not API versioning, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
